gaps.title: No multi-arch Docker builds
gaps.description: CI does not build or push multi-arch (amd64/arm64) Docker images. Edge deployments on Raspberry Pi (ARM64) and Jetson cannot use CI-built images.
gaps.impact: ARM64 edge devices cannot use CI-produced images; manual builds required
gaps.recommended_fix: Add docker/setup-buildx-action and docker/build-push-action with platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64

gaps.title: No GPU node support in CI
gaps.description: CI runs only on ubuntu-latest CPU runners. GPU solver modules (gpu_tsp, gpu_vrp) cannot be tested in CI.
gaps.impact: GPU code paths are untested in CI; regressions go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a GPU runner job (e.g., ubuntu-latest with CUDA or self-hosted GPU runner) that runs GPU-specific tests

gaps.title: No canary deployment strategy
gaps.description: CI has no deployment jobs at all — no staging, production, or canary deployments. All deployment is manual via kubectl.
gaps.impact: No automated rollout, no gradual traffic shifting, no automated rollback on failure
gaps.recommended_fix: Add deploy-staging and deploy-production jobs with canary strategy (e.g., Argo Rollouts or Flagger)

gaps.title: No integration/e2e test stage
gaps.description: CI only runs unit tests (pytest tests/). Integration and e2e tests (test_integration_e2e.py) are not run in CI.
gaps.impact: Integration regressions are not caught before merge
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a separate integration test job that runs pytest -m integration after unit tests pass

gaps.title: No Docker image build/push in CI
gaps.description: CI does not build or push Docker images. Images must be built manually.
gaps.impact: No immutable artifacts; deployments use locally built images
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a docker-build job that builds and pushes images to a registry on tag/release

gaps.title: No K8s deployment in CI
gaps.description: CI has no Kubernetes deployment step. All K8s deployments are manual.
gaps.impact: No GitOps; configuration drift between environments
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a deploy job that applies k8s/ manifests or uses Helm/Kustomize

gaps.title: No dependency vulnerability scanning
gaps.description: CI runs bandit (SAST) but has no Python dependency vulnerability scanning (pip-audit, safety).
gaps.impact: Vulnerable dependencies can be merged undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add pip-audit or safety check to the security job

gaps.title: No container image scanning
gaps.description: No Trivy/grype scanning of Docker images in CI.
gaps.impact: Vulnerable base images or packages go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add trivy image scan after docker build

gaps.title: No secrets scanning
gaps.description: No gitleaks or trufflehog scanning for secrets in CI.
gaps.impact: Accidental secret commits are not caught
gaps.recommended_fix: Add gitleaks-action to CI

gaps.title: No performance benchmarking in CI
gaps.description: No performance regression tests or benchmarks in CI.
gaps.impact: Performance regressions go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a benchmark job using pytest-benchmark or custom timing tests

gaps.title: No OS matrix in CI
gaps.description: CI only runs on ubuntu-latest. No Windows or macOS testing.
gaps.impact: Platform-specific issues may go undetected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] to test matrix

gaps.title: No job dependencies (pipeline stages)
gaps.description: Lint, test, and security jobs run independently with no needs: dependencies.
gaps.impact: No guaranteed ordering; security scan runs even if tests fail
gaps.recommended_fix: Add needs: [lint] to test job, needs: [test] to security job

gaps.title: No timeout-minutes on jobs
gaps.description: Jobs have no timeout-minutes set. A hung job can consume CI minutes indefinitely.
gaps.impact: Wasted CI minutes on hung jobs
gaps.recommended_fix: Add timeout-minutes: 10 to each job

gaps.title: No smoke tests after deployment
gaps.description: No post-deployment smoke tests to verify the deployment succeeded.
gaps.impact: Broken deployments are not automatically detected
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a smoke test step after deployment that curls health endpoints

gaps.title: No database migration step in CI
gaps.description: No database migration step in CI or deployment pipeline.
gaps.impact: Schema changes must be applied manually
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a migration step (e.g., alembic upgrade head) before deployment

gaps.title: No Helm chart or Kustomize configuration
gaps.description: K8s manifests are raw YAML with no Helm chart or Kustomize overlays for environment management.
gaps.impact: Environment-specific configuration is manual and error-prone
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a Helm chart or Kustomize overlays for dev/staging/prod

gaps.title: Python 3.13 excluded from test matrix
gaps.description: Python 3.13 is in classifiers but not in CI test matrix (excluded due to onnx build failure).
gaps.impact: Forward-compatibility with Python 3.13 is untested
gaps.recommended_fix: Add 3.13 to matrix with allow-failures: true until onnx supports it

gaps.title: No branch protection rules visible
gaps.description: No evidence of branch protection rules requiring CI pass before merge.
gaps.impact: Broken code can be merged to main
gaps.recommended_fix: Configure branch protection rules in GitHub settings

gaps.title: No multi-arch build support
gaps.description: Dockerfile has no --platform flags and no ARG for TARGETARCH/TARGETPLATFORM. Cannot build for ARM64.
gaps.impact: ARM64 edge devices (Raspberry Pi, Jetson) cannot use the image
gaps.recommended_fix: Add ARG TARGETARCH, TARGETPLATFORM and use --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM in FROM

gaps.title: No image scanning (Trivy/grype)
gaps.description: No container image vulnerability scanning in CI or Dockerfile.
gaps.impact: Vulnerable images can be deployed
gaps.recommended_fix: Add trivy/grype scan in CI after docker build

gaps.title: No image signing (cosign)
gaps.description: Docker images are not signed. No supply chain security.
gaps.impact: Images cannot be verified for integrity
gaps.recommended_fix: Add cosign sign in CI after image build

gaps.title: No SBOM generation
gaps.description: No Software Bill of Materials is generated for the image.
gaps.impact: No visibility into image contents for compliance
gaps.recommended_fix: Add syft or trivy --format spdx to generate SBOM

gaps.title: No distroless base image option
gaps.description: Uses python:3.11-slim which includes a full OS. Distroless would reduce attack surface.
gaps.impact: Larger attack surface than necessary
gaps.recommended_fix: Add a distroless variant (e.g., gcr.io/distroless/python3.11)

gaps.title: tests/ directory copied into image
gaps.description: COPY . . copies the entire project including tests/ into the runtime image.
gaps.impact: Unnecessary files in production image; larger image size
gaps.recommended_fix: Add tests/ to .dockerignore or use explicit COPY of only src/

gaps.title: No layer optimization (COPY . .)
gaps.description: COPY . . copies everything in one layer, preventing effective layer caching.
gaps.impact: Slower builds; any change invalidates the layer cache
gaps.recommended_fix: Copy only src/ and requirements.txt separately before pip install

gaps.title: No version tagging strategy
gaps.description: Image is only tagged as :latest. No semantic versioning or git sha tags.
gaps.impact: Cannot roll back to specific versions
gaps.recommended_fix: Tag images with git sha and semver (e.g., agtech-unified:1.0.0, agtech-unified:sha-abc123)

gaps.title: No docker-compose.prod.yml
gaps.description: Only one docker-compose.yml for all environments. No production override.
gaps.impact: Cannot have environment-specific compose configuration
gaps.recommended_fix: Add docker-compose.prod.yml with production settings

gaps.title: No GPU runtime in compose
gaps.description: GPU solvers (gpu_tsp, gpu_vrp) need NVIDIA runtime but compose doesn't configure it.
gaps.impact: GPU modules fail in Docker Compose
gaps.recommended_fix: Add runtime: nvidia to app service

gaps.title: No resource limits in compose
gaps.description: No mem_limit or cpus limits on services in docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Services can consume all host resources
gaps.recommended_fix: Add deploy.resources.limits to each service

gaps.title: No healthcheck in compose
gaps.description: No healthcheck defined in docker-compose.yml (only in Dockerfile).
gaps.impact: Docker Compose cannot detect unhealthy containers
gaps.recommended_fix: Add healthcheck to app service in compose

gaps.title: No restart policy in compose
gaps.description: No restart policy defined in docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Containers do not restart on failure
gaps.recommended_fix: Add restart: unless-stopped to services

gaps.title: No network isolation in compose
gaps.description: All services use the default network. No network segmentation.
gaps.impact: No isolation between services
gaps.recommended_fix: Define separate networks for app, db, and messaging

gaps.title: No logging configuration in compose
gaps.description: No logging driver or log rotation configured in docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Log files can grow unbounded
gaps.recommended_fix: Add logging: driver: json-file with max-size and max-file

gaps.title: Hardcoded POSTGRES_PASSWORD in compose
gaps.description: POSTGRES_PASSWORD=agtech is hardcoded in docker-compose.yml.
gaps.impact: Security risk if repo is public
gaps.recommended_fix: Use ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?} from .env

gaps.title: No rolling update strategy
gaps.description: Deployment has no strategy.rollingUpdate (maxSurge, maxUnavailable) configured.
gaps.impact: Default rolling update may cause downtime or resource spikes
gaps.recommended_fix: Add strategy: rollingUpdate: maxSurge: 1, maxUnavailable: 0

gaps.title: No PodDisruptionBudget
gaps.description: No PodDisruptionBudget defined. Voluntary disruptions can take down all pods.
gaps.impact: No minimum availability guarantee during node maintenance
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PodDisruptionBudget with minAvailable: 1

gaps.title: No NetworkPolicy
gaps.description: No NetworkPolicy defined. All pods can communicate freely.
gaps.impact: No network segmentation; lateral movement possible if compromised
gaps.recommended_fix: Add NetworkPolicy to restrict ingress/egress

gaps.title: No securityContext
gaps.description: No securityContext (runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false) on pod or container.
gaps.impact: Container runs with excessive privileges
gaps.recommended_fix: Add securityContext with runAsNonRoot: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true

gaps.title: No ServiceAccount
gaps.description: No ServiceAccount defined. Pods use the default service account.
gaps.impact: Excessive API permissions
gaps.recommended_fix: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount with minimal RBAC

gaps.title: No topologySpreadConstraints
gaps.description: No topologySpreadConstraints. Pods may all schedule on the same node/AZ.
gaps.impact: No high availability across zones
gaps.recommended_fix: Add topologySpreadConstraints with maxSkew: 1, topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone

gaps.title: No affinity/anti-affinity rules
gaps.description: No pod affinity or anti-affinity rules defined.
gaps.impact: No control over pod placement
gaps.recommended_fix: Add podAntiAffinity to spread pods across nodes

gaps.title: No GPU node support
gaps.description: No nodeSelector, tolerations, or GPU resource limits for GPU solver pods.
gaps.impact: GPU modules cannot be scheduled on GPU nodes
gaps.recommended_fix: Add nodeSelector: gpu: 'true' and resources.limits: nvidia.com/gpu: 1

gaps.title: No canary deployment support
gaps.description: No canary deployment configuration (no Istio, Flagger, or Argo Rollouts).
gaps.impact: No gradual traffic shifting for safe rollouts
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Flagger or Argo Rollouts canary configuration

gaps.title: No init containers for migrations
gaps.description: No init container to run database migrations before app starts.
gaps.impact: App may start before schema is ready
gaps.recommended_fix: Add initContainer that runs alembic upgrade head

gaps.title: No persistent volumes
gaps.description: No PersistentVolumeClaim for data storage.
gaps.impact: Data is lost on pod restart
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PVC for application data

gaps.title: No graceful shutdown configuration
gaps.description: No terminationGracePeriodSeconds or preStop hook.
gaps.impact: In-flight requests may be dropped on shutdown
gaps.recommended_fix: Add terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30 and preStop hook

gaps.title: No startup probe
gaps.description: No startup probe defined. Slow-starting containers may be killed by liveness probe.
gaps.impact: Containers that take time to start may be killed prematurely
gaps.recommended_fix: Add startupProbe with failureThreshold: 30, periodSeconds: 10

gaps.title: No HPA behavior configuration
gaps.description: HPA has no behavior configuration for scale-up/scale-down stabilization.
gaps.impact: Potential flapping or slow scale-down
gaps.recommended_fix: Add behavior: scaleDown: stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300

gaps.title: No custom metrics for HPA
gaps.description: HPA only uses CPU and memory. No custom metrics (e.g., request queue depth).
gaps.impact: Cannot scale on application-specific metrics
gaps.recommended_fix: Add custom metrics via Prometheus Adapter

gaps.title: No VPA (Vertical Pod Autoscaler)
gaps.description: No VPA to recommend or set resource requests.
gaps.impact: Resource requests may be misconfigured over time
gaps.recommended_fix: Add VPA in recommendation mode

gaps.title: No resource quotas
gaps.description: No ResourceQuota defined for the namespace.
gaps.impact: No limit on total resource consumption
gaps.recommended_fix: Add ResourceQuota for the namespace

gaps.title: No limit ranges
gaps.description: No LimitRange defined for the namespace.
gaps.impact: No default resource limits for pods without explicit limits
gaps.recommended_fix: Add LimitRange with default requests/limits

gaps.title: No PodSecurityPolicy/PodSecurityAdmission
gaps.description: No PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurityAdmission configuration.
gaps.impact: No enforcement of security standards
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PodSecurityAdmission with restricted profile

gaps.title: No monitoring/alerting rules
gaps.description: No PrometheusRule or alerting configuration in k8s/.
gaps.impact: No automated alerting on issues
gaps.recommended_fix: Add PrometheusRule with alerts for high error rate, latency, etc.

gaps.title: No Kustomize/Helm configuration
gaps.description: Raw YAML manifests with no Kustomize or Helm configuration.
gaps.impact: No environment-specific overlays
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Kustomize overlays or Helm chart

gaps.title: No environment-specific overlays
gaps.description: No dev/staging/prod overlays for K8s manifests.
gaps.impact: Environment configuration is manual
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Kustomize overlays for each environment

gaps.title: No backup strategy
gaps.description: No backup configuration for persistent data.
gaps.impact: Data loss risk
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Velero or similar backup solution

gaps.title: No secrets encryption at rest
gaps.description: No etcd encryption or external secrets operator.
gaps.impact: Secrets stored in plaintext in etcd
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable etcd encryption or use External Secrets Operator

gaps.title: No cert-manager Certificate resource
gaps.description: Ingress references a ClusterIssuer but no Certificate resource is defined.
gaps.impact: TLS certificates may not be provisioned automatically
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Certificate resource for agtech-unified-tls

gaps.title: No rate limiting at ingress
gaps.description: No rate limiting annotations on the Ingress.
gaps.impact: API is vulnerable to abuse
gaps.recommended_fix: Add nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps annotation

gaps.title: No WAF configuration
gaps.description: No Web Application Firewall configuration.
gaps.impact: No protection against common web attacks
gaps.recommended_fix: Add ModSecurity or cloud WAF

gaps.title: No audit logging
gaps.description: No Kubernetes audit logging configuration.
gaps.impact: No audit trail of API server actions
gaps.recommended_fix: Enable audit logging with appropriate policy

gaps.title: No service mesh integration
gaps.description: No Istio/Linkerd service mesh configuration.
gaps.impact: No mTLS, traffic management, or observability from mesh
gaps.recommended_fix: Evaluate Istio or Linkerd for mTLS and traffic management

gaps.title: No distributed tracing configuration
gaps.description: No OpenTelemetry or Jaeger configuration in K8s manifests.
gaps.impact: No distributed tracing in production
gaps.recommended_fix: Add OpenTelemetry Collector sidecar or daemonset
